options.label: A divine punishment
options.summary: Vampires descend from a scapegoat for human evil, cursed to spend eternity in darkness.

options.label: A genetic mutation
options.summary: Vampires are a separate species, or subspecies, from mortal humans.

options.label: The result of a failed ritual
options.summary: Vampires descend from a sorcerer who attempted a ritual for eternal life but failed to control its effects.

categories.title: Innate Powers
categories.prompt: A vampire's innate powers and blight are…

options.label: Inherited from their progenitor
options.summary: Supernatural characteristics reflect those of your progenitor.

options.label: Seemingly random
options.summary: No way to tell what powers or blight a vampire will develop.

options.label: Influenced by their personality
options.summary: Innate powers reflect the vampire's personality in some way.

categories.title: Population
categories.prompt: How many vampires exist among mortals?

options.label: Very few
options.summary: Minimal influence over mortal society; rarely meet in groups.

options.label: Some
options.summary: Considerable (even if narrow) influence; gather in popular meeting places.

options.label: Many
options.summary: Influence over most spheres of mortal existence; vampires are everywhere.

categories.title: Political Landscape
categories.prompt: Your city's political landscape is marked primarily by…

options.label: Unity
options.summary: The entire city is ruled by a central government body called the Concord.

options.label: Conflict
options.summary: Most of the city is ruled by the Concord; the rest by dissident factions.

options.label: Division
options.summary: Multiple independent factions, all independent from each other.

categories.title: Loyalty
categories.prompt: The faction a vampire belongs to is…

options.label: Chosen by her
options.summary: Usually the same as her progenitor's; principles taught before turning.

options.label: Inherited from her progenitor
options.summary: Leaving it is illegal; leavers survive in exile unless valuable elsewhere.

options.label: Determined by the region where she was transformed
options.summary: Progenitors turn in their own faction's region; other leaders claim the progeny.

categories.title: Hunting Territory
categories.prompt: Besides their own place, where can vampires hunt and feed?

options.label: Wherever they have access to
options.summary: Common sense is the only rule: avoid being noticed or feeding from someone else's prey.

options.label: In specific feeding grounds
options.summary: Every district has a designated feeding ground; feeding elsewhere in public is illegal.

options.label: In their home's surroundings
options.summary: Feeding more than one block away from home is asking for trouble.

categories.title: Sunlight
categories.prompt: When vampires go out in the sun, they…

options.label: Combust into a pile of ash
options.summary: Sunlight incinerates vampires beyond recognition.

options.label: Decay into a pile of bones
options.summary: Body turns to dust; bones stay intact and dry, instantly preserved.

options.label: Become solid statues
options.summary: Destroyed vampires look like realistic stone sculptures; material varies.

categories.title: District Access
categories.prompt: Can you linger in (not just pass through) other factions' districts?

options.label: Yes, but don't cause trouble
options.summary: Common sense, not laws, limits activity; mind your business.

options.label: If you announce yourself at a border post
options.summary: Every territorial frontier has a watched border post to present yourself at.

options.label: If you are personally invited
options.summary: You must be someone's guest; seen alone, you're in trouble.

categories.title: Witches
categories.prompt: Mortals that study and practice magic are…

options.label: So rare most believe they don't exist
options.summary: If they do, they're extremely well hidden.

options.label: Uncommon
options.summary: Small covens; not powerful enough for real political influence.

options.label: Common and well-organized
options.summary: Many diverse covens, some rivaling vampire factions.

options.label: Rare and unorganized
options.summary: Lone vigilantes; underprepared but still dangerous.

options.label: Uncommon, but organized
options.summary: Vigilantes plus religious or intelligence organizations; serious when they show up.

options.label: Widespread
options.summary: Religious orders and government agents operate frequently; a secret war.

categories.title: Werewolves
categories.prompt: Humans who turn into large wolves are…

options.label: Present but uncommon
options.summary: Small packs; avoid trouble but highly territorial and violent.

options.label: Common within this city
options.summary: Another part of the urban underworld; often diplomatic, lingering animosity.

options.label: Mostly in the wilds and outskirts
options.summary: Large packs, fiercely territorial, destroy vampires without a second thought.

categories.title: Fey
categories.prompt: Ethereal beings born in the land of dreams are…

options.label: Nothing but a myth
options.summary: Few vampires have seen a Fey; those who have are often discredited.

options.label: Rare and extremely well hidden
options.summary: Alone or in small groups; crossing paths usually means trouble.

options.label: Common enough to hold real power
options.summary: Organized into factions; sometimes cooperate when goals align.
